# Cron

Explain a cron expression and list its next runs.

Category: Converters · ID: `cron` · Search terms: crontab, schedule, job, quartz, @daily

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui cron [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Expression (min hour day month weekday)

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--seconds` | on/off | `false` | Seconds field. 6 fields: the first one is seconds |
| `--tz` | text | `Local` | Zone. Local, UTC or an IANA name (America/Bogota) |
| `--count` | 1–50 | `10` | Next runs. |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/cron`), so they are what the tool prints.

### every-15-bogota

```text
Every 15 minutes

Next runs (America/Bogota):
  Fri 2026-11-20 03:30  (in 15 min)
  Fri 2026-11-20 03:45  (in 30 min)
  Fri 2026-11-20 04:00  (in 45 min)
  Fri 2026-11-20 04:15  (in 1 h)
  Fri 2026-11-20 04:30  (in 1 h)
```

### seconds

```text
Every 10 seconds, at minute 0, past hour 12, on Monday

Next runs (UTC):
  Mon 2026-11-23 12:00:00  (in 3 d)
  Mon 2026-11-23 12:00:10  (in 3 d)
  Mon 2026-11-23 12:00:20  (in 3 d)
```
